public_definitions: The task requires selecting the service category with the highest feedback share from the dashboard.
The dashboard is the 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' chart.
The selection must be based on the 'Value' (feedback share) shown on the y-axis.
The chosen category will be routed to the 'highest-share service-planning follow-up workflow'.
